confidenceNote_criticalDiscrepancy: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT for Kicheche Laikipia pricing across two source files, both on file in the same folder and both labeled 'Nett'/'Full Board': the standalone '2026 Kicheche FB Rates.pdf' (issued 4 Dec 2025) states Peak adult $470, Mid $360, Regular $325; single supplement Peak $185/Mid $110/Regular $110. The 'PREF TO Rates.pdf' (updated 24 Jul 2025) states its own 'Nett Rates' for Kicheche Laikipia as Peak adult $645, Mid $485, Regular $425 - single supplement Peak $180/Mid $115/Regular $105. These are materially different adult base rates for what should be the same Nett/preferred tier (FB Rates file is ~$175-200 lower per night at every season). Conservancy fees match exactly between the two documents ($187 adult/$94 child), so it is not a currency or fee-inclusion difference. The FB Rates file is dated later (Dec 2025) than the PREF TO file (Jul 2025) which might suggest it supersedes it, but it is also the ONLY one of the three source files that does not carry a Rack-rate column for comparison, and its own child/young-adult age brackets and structure differ slightly (no explicit '12-17 young adult' row, unlike PREF TO/Rack). Do not silently pick one - confirm directly with Kicheche which Laikipia Nett rate is current before quoting.
